security_audit.summary: Four alerts match Markdown filenames or MCP tool names, not shell commands. The entropy alert matches readable bilingual UTF-8 text, with no evidence of obfuscation. The optional ordering workflow permits a real purchase but does not specify what the user must review before confirming.

remediation.issue: Optional order creation lacks defined confirmation requirements.
remediation.suggestion: Remove order creation from the coaching skill. If ordering is retained, require separate opt-in and show the items, quantities, total, and fulfillment details before explicit confirmation. Request fresh confirmation if any detail changes.

content.value_statement: FriesCraft towers can collapse when their weight shifts or the wind picks up. Get specific placement advice and learn what the game's stability indicators mean.
actual_capabilities: Explain the differences between gallery, free build, and challenge modes.
Suggest stable foundations, tapered layers, and adjustments for windy challenges.
Explain placement previews, center-of-mass colors, and the challenge timer.
Give piece counts for two dinosaur builds and point to the in-game gallery for other blueprints.
Look up nutrition, promotions, stores, and party events when the relevant MCP tools are connected.
limitations: The skill provides coaching and does not include the browser game.
The coach cannot see the current build or place pieces for the player.
Most sculpture recipes require the in-game gallery.
Live menu and store information requires the relevant MCP integration.

use_cases.title: Build a First Stable Tower
use_cases.description: Learn how to use three leaning fries as a stable starting structure in free build mode.

use_cases.title: Finish a Windy Challenge
use_cases.description: Get advice on keeping a tower steady at the height target with a limited supply of fries.

use_cases.title: Plan a Dinosaur Build
use_cases.description: Use the piece count for a small dinosaur or choose a gallery blueprint for a different sculpture.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Stable Tower
prompt_templates.prompt: I am new to free build mode. Show me how to make a stable base with three fries.

prompt_templates.title: Follow a Dinosaur Blueprint
prompt_templates.prompt: How many fries and nuggets does the triceratops blueprint use? Tell me where to find it in the game.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Leaning Tower
prompt_templates.prompt: My tower leans right after I add its top layer. The center-of-mass marker turns orange. What should I change first?

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Wind Challenge
prompt_templates.prompt: I have six fries left in a windy challenge. Suggest a placement sequence that adds height. Explain when the five-second timer starts.

output_examples.input: How can I stop my tower from leaning after adding a layer?
output: Move the top pieces inward so the upper layer is narrower than the one below.
Check the center-of-mass marker after each placement. Green indicates stability, orange means it is wobbling, and red warns of instability.
For your next attempt, place the heavier pieces near the bottom.

output_examples.input: My tower is tall enough. Why has the timer not started?
output: The countdown starts only when the tower meets the height target and stability exceeds 96 percent.
Give the pieces time to settle. If wind keeps the top moving, shorten any long overhangs.

output_examples.input: What do I need for the triceratops build?
output_examples.output: The triceratops uses two nuggets and fourteen fries. Select its blueprint in the in-game gallery.

best_practices: State the game mode, remaining piece count, and what happened during your last placement.
Check the center-of-mass marker after each adjustment before adding height.
Use current MCP results for nutrition or store information when the tools are available.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the coach to place pieces or read your game screen.
Do not add tall, wide overhangs when wind is already moving the tower.
Do not treat example calorie values as current for every location or serving size.

faq.question: Does this skill include the game?
faq.answer: No. Open the separate FriesCraft game in your browser and use the skill for coaching.

faq.question: Do I need MCP to get building advice?
faq.answer: No. MCP is optional and is used for live McDonald's information and ordering.

faq.question: Can the coach inspect my current tower?
faq.answer: No. Describe the base, top layer, and stability indicator so the coach can suggest a change.

faq.question: Where do I find all twelve sculpture blueprints?
faq.answer: Open the in-game gallery. The skill itself gives piece counts for two dinosaur builds.

faq.question: Where does the game save challenge records?
faq.answer: The game saves the fewest fries used at each difficulty in the current browser's local storage.

faq.question: Can the skill place a food order?
faq.answer: With compatible MCP tools, the documented workflow can place an order after an explicit request and confirmation. Review all order details before confirming.
